Hermit lizard

Biography

Hermit lizard helps Zak escape the Khadaganian expedition in return for a promise to visit his home. He then asks Zak to restore water diverted by the orcs. In exchange he shares what the lizards know of the ancient magician and explains the tunnel route toward his dwelling, including its dangerous golems. His attempts at human humour are considerably less reassuring. [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]
